Pattern

Description

The pattern component is a configurable container for UL's Graphic Patterns, which are inspired by the campus topography, the river Shannon and the living bridge.

They are decorative and should be used to enhance a design but should never obscure any information. Our patterns should only ever be used in our primary or mono colours.

Syntax

Use the include tag to inject a pattern, and the only keyword if it needs to be protected from outside scope.

{% include 'ul:pattern' with {
  property: 'value'
  ...
} only %}

Properties

A pattern has one mandatory and six optional properties.

Name Type Description Options
clip_path string Accepts any valid CSS clip-path syntax. [Default: none] n/a
fill string The pattern's fill colour. [Default: bg-heritage] n/a
id string An optional id for the pattern. [Default: none] n/a
modifiers string Add-on modifier classes in case further customisation is needed. [Default: none] n/a
name* string The pattern name. Must be one of the six defined pattern names. [Default: 1A] 1A, 1B, 1C, 2A, 2B, 2C
overrides string Allows a full take-over of the component classes if modifiers are not enough. [Default: none] n/a
size string The size of the pattern, which can be defined by size-*, h-* or w-* utility classes. [Default: none] n/a
* Denotes a required property.

Examples

Below are some examples of how to customise the colour, size, add a clip-path and inject further modifier classes where needed.

Fill and Size

The default fill of a pattern is fill-white and the default size is w-48 h-auto (192px in width with automatic height).

In the below example, the fill and size are modified for each pattern.

{% include 'ul:pattern' with {
  name: '2C',
  size: 'w-36 h-auto',
  fill: 'fill-heritage'
} only %}

{% include 'ul:pattern' with {
  name: '2B',
  size: 'w-48 h-auto',
  fill: 'fill-modern'
} only %}

{% include 'ul:pattern' with {
  name: '2A',
  size: 'w-64 h-auto',
  fill: 'fill-green'
} only %}

Clip-path

Pattern components also support custom clipping, via clip-path syntax. In the following example a polygon shape is used to clip the top right portion of the pattern:

{% include 'ul:pattern' with {
  name: '1C',
  fill: 'fill-heritage',
  clip_path: 'polygon(0% 0%, 80% 0%, 80% 30%, 100% 30%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)'
} only %}

Customisation

Further customisation can be done via the modifiers property. In the below example the pattern is placed behind another partially-transparent div.

<div class='relative bg-green p-14'>
  {% include 'ul:pattern' with {
    name: '1A',
    modifiers: 'absolute top-7 left-7'
  } only %}
  <div class='relative z-10 h-64 bg-heritage/70'></div>
</div>

Source Code

The source code below can be found below, and at inc/components/pattern/ in the design system repository.

Twig

{# Set component defaults. #}
{% set clip_path = clip_path ? 'style="clip-path: ' ~ clip_path ~ '"' : '' %}
{% set id = id ? 'id="' ~ id ~ '"' : '' %}
{% set fill = fill ?? 'fill-white' %}
{% set name = name in ['1A', '1B', '1C', '2A', '2B', '2C'] ? name : '1A' %}
{% set size = size ?? 'w-48 h-auto' %}

{# Set up the component classes. #}
{% set classes = overrides is empty ? [size, fill, modifiers]|join(' ') : overrides %}

{# The component markup. #}
<div
  {{ id }}
  {{ clip_path }}
  class="{{ classes }}"
  >
  {% include '@patterns/0' ~ name ~ '.svg' %}
</div>

YML

name: Pattern
props:
  type: object
  required:
    - name
  properties:
    clip_path:
      title: clip_path
      type: string
      description: Accepts any valid CSS clip-path syntax.
    fill:
      title: fill
      type: string
      description: The pattern's fill colour.
      default: bg-heritage
    id:
      title: id
      type: string
      description: An optional id for the pattern.
    modifiers:
      title: modifiers
      type: string
      description: Add-on modifier classes in case further customisation is needed.
    name:
      title: name
      type: string
      description: The pattern name. Must be one of the six defined pattern names.
      enum:
        - 1A
        - 1B
        - 1C
        - 2A
        - 2B
        - 2C
      default: 1A
    overrides:
      title: overrides
      type: string
      description: Allows a full take-over of the component classes if modifiers are not enough.
    size:
      title: size
      type: string
      description: The size of the pattern, which can be defined by size-*, h-* or w-* utility classes.
